runs.name: China Everbright Environment Group Limited; HKEX 00257, US over-the-counter CHFFF, not an SEC registrant, reports on HKEXnews in Hong Kong dollars; builds and operates environmental infrastructure in the PRC under service concessions, chiefly waste-to-energy plants, with waste-water treatment and other environmental services, paid by local governments, the State Grid and the national renewable-energy subsidy; Central Huijin holds 43.08% through China Everbright Group; CEO resigned 2026-07-17, the Chairman acting; the annual reports name no rival
runs.file: 2026-10-29 Run - CHFFF China Everbright Environment Group.md
runs.box: OUT AT Q2 (the deciding part's castle stands for each concession's term but protects only ordinary returns, the next contract won by tender and the payers in arrears; computation only beneath the stop)
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch, then RESUMED: the 12:00 cycle's analyst wrote Step 0 to Q1 and was ended by a usage limit (cycle log 2026-10-29_1200, RATE LIMITED); the 13:00 cycle dispatched a second analyst with the resume paragraph, who committed the first analyst's uncommitted sovereign edit and wrote Q2 to the self-audit. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's business review, principal risks and management discussion (in place of a 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7); HKEXnews documents named by title, date and file number in place of accession numbers; the sovereign for the renminbi from its issuing authority, since the protocol's table has no CNY row. Price **HK$4.735** for 00257 (close 2026-10-28, Yahoo, aggregator, flagged; CHFFF over the counter US$0.60, thinly traded) x **6,142,975,292 shares** (Monthly Return for September 2026, HKEXnews 2026100202491; checked against AR2025 note 33 and basic EPS) = cap **HK$29,087m**; sovereign **2.05%** (renminbi 30-year, the Ministry of Finance of the PRC curve served by ChinaBond, 2026-10-28); renminbi taken as the earnings currency, 96% of 2025 revenue from the PRC. Filings: Annual Reports 2016 to 2025, Interim Report 2026 (2026-09-16), announcements of 2023-02-24, 2024-03-27, 2025-11-14, 2025-12-11, 2026-07-17, 2026-10-26; rival Dynagreen Environmental Protection (HKEX 01330) Annual Reports 2020, 2022, 2025. **Q1 IN**: environmental energy decides, fixed-term concessions whose variables the filings state, China's lower-price condition carried. **Q2 OUT**: environmental energy 70.4% of five-year segment profit; concessions of 20 to 41 years with guaranteed minimum payments, each plant handed back for nothing at expiry; new contracts by tender in a market the filer says "has shrunk sharply"; 2 of 161 operating plants won a fee rise in 2025; the filer says "the ability of governments at all levels to pay has been impaired", debtors over 13 months HK$13.7bn of HK$27.5bn at 2026-06-30, about 45% of arrears national subsidy, litigation started to collect; the deciding segment earns 5.6% to 5.7% before interest and tax on its assets (2024, 2025); profit over equity 14.0% to 5.4% here and about 11% to 7.1% at the rival over the decade. The regulated-return exception weighed hardest and judged not to apply: no regulator allows a return on capital, the fee is won by bid, the power tariff is a flat national price, and the guarantors are in arrears. Q3 to Q12 NOT REACHED. Balance sheet 2016 to 2025: concession assets quadrupled to HK$102bn by 2021 on borrowings HK$21.6bn to HK$99.1bn and a HK$10bn rights issue at HK$6.00 (2018); from 2022 the build stopped, borrowings to HK$88.5bn, HK$7.8bn of perpetual capital instruments issued; debtors up seventeenfold while revenue doubled and fell back. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: segment measure is adjusted EBITDA; construction revenue and accrued concession finance income ahead of cash; RMB1,440m of subsidy receivables sold to a trust in 2025 with liquidity support kept; impairments 2025 about HK$0.8bn; Poland goodwill HK$590m written off 2022; auditor rotation 2024 under the state-owned-enterprise rule, no circumstances; borrowings HK$90.5bn at 2026-06-30, HK$31.0bn due within a year against HK$9.9bn cash; proposed issue of up to 800M RMB shares at about 0.56 times book (2025-11-14); no buybacks, no options; no integrity fact found, no flag. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash all-equity HK$m 2021 -12,007, 2022 -1,852, 2023 -1,351, 2024 4,416, 2025 10,277, average **-103**, equity basis -3,284; perpetuals and minorities at book counted as claims (a CONVENTION of the run); value **HK$-17.54 a share**, the no-growth case alone (the series changes sign); fair price all-equity **HK$-16.89**, not positive, equity-only HK$-4.64; cases beside (2025 less the receivables sale, the 2024-25 average, a maintenance guess) give HK$34.89 to HK$52.46 at the sovereign but at best 6.6% on enterprise value at the price; no all-equity case earns the floor. Could not get: cost per tonne against a rival (Q2's low-cost test unanswered); a second filing rival (none named; Dynagreen chosen by the analyst, from its five-year highlights only); the full connected-transaction renewal. Framework gaps for the operator: whether the regulated-return exception needs a return on capital allowed by a regulator or only a price set by one, and what follows when the guarantor is in arrears (a second analyst could carry the file to Q3); specific (a) has no rule for a one-off build-out that does not repeat; no CNY row in the sovereign table. Write-early: the first analyst committed twice (65d3eeb0, 7715ef97); the second committed the predecessor's edit (165b4757), then Q2 and everything after in one commit (de386227), declared in the self-audit, then 90e60f95. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, all 39 ids in the ledger, 24 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `_dispatcher_cite_check.py`, two flagged and resolved by hand: one is a filing quotation beside an id (no slip); one is a form slip, Q2 quotes the framework's own words "a return set by a regulator" directly beside **[M2009-104]**, whose row does not contain them (the row's own words, "more or less" and "a guaranteed return", follow in the same sentence); recorded here, the run file not edited. No tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: CDTG commit subjects in the opening git context, the first analyst's commit subjects and its draft script header saying the file closed at Q2, the project map and memory index; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2: a state-controlled Chinese waste-to-energy concession group whose plants are full and whose contracts guarantee minimum payments, but whose castle protects only ordinary returns (5% to 7% on equity in the operating years, as at its listed rival), with new contracts won by tender, 2 of 161 plants granted a fee rise in 2025, and local governments and the national subsidy in arrears; HK$31.0bn of borrowings due within a year against HK$9.9bn cash; computation only, owner cash averaged HK$-103m a year 2021 to 2025, value HK$-17.54 and fair price HK$-16.89 a share against HK$4.735. Not armed.
